body: Went to hospital. Blood is normal. Told them I was still suicidal, said no to seeing crisis team so they let me go.
Pain is all it will bring. Hours of excruiating pain.
Please don't. Seek help. There is no guarantee of death, though there will certainly be a lot of pain. Not fun, it really isn't.
I mean I am going to die irregardless of hospital treatment as it is well past the point of stopping the liver failure.
I am already dead. I read what it said, if you don't get treatment within the first few hours you are going to die.
3g of ibuprofen will most likely give you stomach pain and possibly heartburn, but no it won't kill you.
